_doc: Welt „oper“ (Opernball-Nacht): Kulissen (2304×768, kachelbar) und Props (1024², transparent). Erzeugung: FAL_KEY=… node tools/fredrun2/fal-art.mjs batch tools/fredrun2/art_prompts/oper.json --out <dir>

styles.scene: 2D side-scrolling game parallax layer, stylized painterly illustration with soft gradients, rich lighting and glowing lights, polished cheerful high-end mobile endless-runner art style. Seen straight from the front in a flat orthographic side view without perspective tilt. The image must tile seamlessly horizontally: the far left edge and the far right edge continue each other. No characters, no people, no text, no logos, no watermark.
styles.prop: Game asset illustration in bold comic style with thick black outlines and halftone shading, vibrant saturated colors, cheerful Austrian mobile endless-runner look. Single isolated object, centered, seen from the side, fully transparent background, no ground shadow, no text, no watermark.

jobs.name: oper-far-ballroom
jobs.prompt: Back wall of a grand baroque opera ballroom filling the whole image: tall arched windows with red velvet curtains, gilded columns, several tiers of opera boxes with golden ornaments, huge sparkling crystal chandeliers hanging from a painted ceiling, warm golden light, rich reds and golds, slightly hazy depth, the lower part of the image is empty polished floor area in darker warm tones.

jobs.name: oper-far-foyer
jobs.prompt: Grand opera house foyer filling the whole image: white and cream marble columns with gold trim, sweeping marble staircases with a red carpet, gilded railings, glowing crystal chandeliers, warm light, elegant cream, white, red and gold palette, the lower part is empty marble floor in darker tones.

jobs.name: oper-far-boxes
jobs.prompt: Dramatic opera house auditorium filling the whole image: several curved tiers of opera boxes with gilded balustrades and deep red velvet, dark warm shadows, glowing golden lamps, a huge central chandelier, an ornate painted ceiling above, deep crimson and gold palette, the lower part is a dark red carpeted floor.

jobs.name: oper-far-mirror
jobs.prompt: Hall of mirrors in a baroque palace filling the whole image: enormous gold-framed mirrors between tall arched windows, reflections of endless chandeliers and candles, silver, champagne and pale blue palette with gold accents, sparkling light, the lower part is empty polished marble floor with soft reflections.

jobs.name: oper-far-midnight
jobs.prompt: Grand ballroom at midnight filling the whole image: tall windows showing a dark night sky with colorful fireworks bursting over Vienna, golden chandeliers, floating confetti and streamers, deep blue, gold and magenta palette, festive and magical, the lower part is empty dark polished floor.

jobs.name: oper-mid-columns
jobs.prompt: Middle-ground row of gilded white marble columns with golden capitals, tall flower arrangements in golden vases, potted palms and red velvet rope barriers between them, seen from the front, widely spaced so a lot of empty space is between the objects. All objects rest on the bottom edge of the image, everything above is transparent.

jobs.name: oper-mid-tables
jobs.prompt: Middle-ground row of elegant banquet tables with white tablecloths, champagne towers, tall candelabras, flower centerpieces, cake stands and velvet chairs, plus two tall gilded mirrors on stands, seen from the front, widely spaced. All objects rest on the bottom edge of the image, everything above is transparent.

jobs.name: oper-near-curtain
jobs.prompt: Foreground framing elements with strong dark red tones: thick draped red velvet curtains with gold tassels hanging from the top edge at a few places, gilded balustrade posts, huge dark flower bouquets in urns at the bottom, very sparse composition with wide transparent gaps, rim lighting in gold.

jobs.name: oper-ground-parquet
jobs.prompt: Side-on strip of a polished herringbone parquet ballroom floor with warm honey-colored wood, glossy reflections of golden light, the top edge has a thin gold trim line, the strip fills the whole image from top to bottom.

jobs.name: oper-ground-carpet
jobs.prompt: Side-on strip of a deep red carpet with an ornate golden border pattern and tassel fringe on the top edge, plush velvet texture, the strip fills the whole image from top to bottom.

jobs.name: oper-piano
jobs.prompt: A black glossy grand piano seen from the side with the lid closed, gold-trimmed legs, and a small red velvet piano stool next to it.

jobs.name: oper-champagne
jobs.prompt: A tall pyramid tower of champagne coupe glasses with golden bubbly wine flowing down, sparkles, on a small white table with gold trim.

jobs.name: oper-chandelier
jobs.prompt: A small sparkling crystal chandelier with lit candles hanging from a golden chain at the top edge of the image, chain leading up out of the frame, gold and crystal.

jobs.name: oper-waiter
jobs.prompt: A comic waiter in a black tailcoat with white gloves balancing a tray full of champagne glasses on one hand, hurrying in a running pose facing right, mustache, funny determined face.

jobs.name: oper-dancers
jobs.prompt: A comic waltz-dancing couple in mid-spin: a gentleman in white-tie tailcoat and a lady in a huge sparkling red ball gown, holding each other in dance pose, cheerful faces, facing right.

jobs.name: oper-cakecart
jobs.prompt: A gilded serving trolley with silver dome cloches, a big Sachertorte with chocolate glaze and a slice cut out, cream bowls and small pastries, on four small wheels.

jobs.name: oper-harp
jobs.prompt: A tall golden concert harp with ornate carved column and glittering strings, standing upright.

jobs.name: oper-bouquet
jobs.prompt: A huge lush bouquet of red roses, white lilies and greenery in a tall golden vase with ribbon.

jobs.name: oper-rope
jobs.prompt: Two short golden stanchion posts connected by a thick red velvet rope hanging in a curve between them.

jobs.name: oper-spotlight
jobs.prompt: A vintage theater spotlight on a black tripod stand with a big round lens, aimed to the upper right, warm white glow from the lens.

jobs.name: oper-cork
jobs.prompt: A champagne cork flying through the air trailing a little foam spray and golden sparkles, pointing right.

jobs.name: oper-note
jobs.prompt: A shiny golden coin with an embossed treble clef (G clef) symbol in the middle, bevelled edge, glossy highlights, front view.

jobs.name: oper-mask
jobs.prompt: An elegant Venetian masquerade half-mask in red and gold with feathers and small jewels, front view.
